AUTHOR: Cheng
TITLE: Construction and Testing of an Underwater Fish Detection Dataset in the Sanjiangyuan Region
REGION: Sanjiangyuan Region, Qinghai, China (Make River, Zhaling Lake, Ngoring Lake)
SPECIES: 21 native plateau fishes incl. Sichuan taimen, Euchiloglanis gracilicaudata, Schizothorax lissolabiatus, wide-tooth schizothoracin
DATA: SJUFD: 4,200 images from field video surveys plus publicly available resources
V_EV: Sec. III.A: 'scenes under various weather and lighting conditions were specifically selected during data acquisition'; 'Blurry frames, heavily occluded frames, and frames without fish were eliminated.'
D_EV: Sec. III.D: 'the dataset is randomly partitioned into training, validation, and test sets at a ratio of 8:1:1'; filenames 'randomly shuffled and allocated'
R_EV: Sec. III.D: random 8:1:1 split of SJUFD; Table I reports only SJUFD test results
E_EV: Table I: only 'Box(P) R mAP@0.5 mAP@0.5:0.95' reported (YOLOv8 0.97, 0.937, 0.989, 0.879)
ARCH: YOLOv3, YOLOv5, YOLOv8, YOLOv10, YOLOv11, YOLOv12 baselines
NOTE: INCL borderline: dataset mixes own field video frames from plateau rivers/lakes with 'publicly available resources' of unstated provenance (possibly non-in-situ); camera/platform not described. Frames extracted from videos and randomly split by file -> image/frame random with likely near-duplicate leakage (not discussed). Blurry/occluded frames removed; lighting/weather variety stated qualitatively (V3=Y); no visibility measurement. Table I test image counts (300/412) inconsistent with stated 420 test images. Data availability not stated.
